inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def get_color (t : Node) : Color :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ _ _ => c
  | Node.Empty => Color.Black -- Empty nodes are black

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def get_left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => some l | _ => none

def get_right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => some r | _ => none

def is_not_empty (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with | Node.Empty => False | _ => True

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  match t with
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ =>
    -- Strictly match Dafny/Verus: Only require Left child to be Red.
    -- The Double-Red context is checked by the caller (insert), not this helper.
    is_red l
  | _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def rotate_right (t : Node) 
    (h_precond : rotate_right_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v l r =>
    match l with
    | Node.Tree _ lv ll lr => Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
    | Node.Empty => t
  | Node.Empty => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def rotate_right_postcond (t : Node) (result : Node)
    (_ : rotate_right_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  view result = view t ∧
  is_bst t → is_bst result ∧
  match result, t with
  | Node.Tree c' _ _ r', Node.Tree c _ _ _ =>
      -- New root color matches old root color
      c' = c ∧
      -- New right child is Red
      (match r' with
       | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => True
       | _ => False) ∧
      -- Black height preservation
      (black_height t ≠ -1 → black_height result = black_height t)
  | _, _ => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem bh_tree_eq (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c v l r)
      = if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r then
          (if c == Color.Black then black_height l + 1 else black_height l)
        else -1 := rfl

theorem bh_red_eq (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l r)
      = if black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r then
          black_height l
        else -1 := rfl

    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) ≠ -1) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r))
      = black_height (Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r) := by
  by_cases hin : black_height ll ≠ -1 ∧ black_height lr ≠ -1 ∧
      black_height ll = black_height lr
  · have hL : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) = black_height ll := by
      rw [bh_red_eq, if_pos hin]
    by_cases hout : black_height ll ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
        black_height ll = black_height r
    · have hBD : black_height lr ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
          black_height lr = black_height r := by
        refine ⟨hin.2.1, hout.2.1, ?_⟩
        have e1 := hin.2.2
        have e2 := hout.2.2
        omega
      have hR : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r) = black_height lr := by
        rw [bh_red_eq, if_pos hBD]
      rw [bh_tree_eq c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r),
          bh_tree_eq c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r, hR, hL,
          if_pos hin, if_pos hout]
    · rw [bh_tree_eq c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r, hL, if_neg hout] at h

      rw [bh_red_eq, if_neg hin]
    rw [bh_tree_eq c v (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) r, hL] at h
    simp at h
